Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sonali - 40 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Nitin - 42 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Savitri - 74 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Zoya - 13 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Zoya stand near him.]

Sonali: "What lovely weather!"

[Tanay searches for his lost ball.]

Sonali: "Well done!"

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Zoya (surprised): "Show me too!"

[Tanay smiles at Mother.]

Zoya: "Show me too!"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Tanay (surprised): "Careful!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Sonali: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay milks the cow.]

Tanay: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's begin."

[Tanay combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Tanay: "Hmm, I see."

[Tanay slams the door shut.]

Tanay: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The classroom - Day

Tanay: "Let's begin."

[Tanay raises his hand to answer.]

Sonali: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Tanay writes on the blackboard.]

Nitin (softly): "Okay, Zoya."

[Tanay reads his book at his desk.]

Tanay: "Careful!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Tanay stands in the courtyard. Sonali, Savitri and Zoya stand near him.]

Tanay: "Let's begin."

[Tanay opens his umbrella.]

Tanay: "Grandma, look at this."

[Tanay puts on his raincoat.]

Zoya: "Yes, of course."

[The rain stops.]

Savitri: "What a day to remember!"
